postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-0 Manchester City: Cash on the money as Emery's men rebound
postReview.description: Aston Villa racked up a fourth straight Premier League win as Matty Cash's first-half effort sank Manchester City at Villa Park.

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-0 Manchester City: Cash risolve la partita mentre gli uomini di Emery si riprendono

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-0 Manchester City: Cash brilha e time de Emery reage

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-0 Manchester City: Cash bringt das Geld, als Emerys Team zurückschlägt
